request: 여행선택에 간결한 목록 보기 전환 버튼 추가. 이미지 목업 후 구현.
prompt:
Create a TripLOG travel selection UI mockup showing the same screen in two selectable view modes, side by side, each designed for a 390 × 844 px mobile viewport. Match the established app identity: warm ivory #fffdf7, dark ink #202730, small yellow #ffeb50 selected accents, pastel blue, pink and mint, clean readable Pretendard-like Korean typography, and restrained dark outlines. The wordmark is bold rounded black “TRIP” followed by “LOG” inside a pink rounded outlined box.

Both screens share the existing header: wordmark at upper left, mint circular profile button at upper right, title “내 여행”, subtitle “떠날 여행도, 다녀온 순간도”, search field “여행 이름이나 여행지 검색”, and compact filters “ALL 3”, “UP NEXT 1”, “MEMORIES 2”. Under the filters, place a small “3개의 여행” count on the left and a clearly labeled two-option segmented view switch on the right: “여권” with a grid icon and “목록” with a list icon. Make the selected option yellow.

Left screen: “여권” is selected and the existing two-column pastel passport collection is visible, with hand-drawn destination illustrations and a yellow “새 여행 만들기” passport.

Right screen: “목록” is selected. Present a simple compact vertical list using thin dividers, small pastel location icons, clear trip names, readable dates, destination labels and small status labels. Use the sample trips “강릉 주말여행” / “강릉 · 대한민국” / “2026.10.24 – 10.25” / “D-7”; “오사카 여행” / “오사카 · 일본” / “2026.09.25 – 09.28” / “지난 여행”; and “제주 여행” / “제주 · 대한민국” / “2026.06.09 – 06.16” / “지난 여행”. The trip information is the main tap target, with a separate discreet remove icon at the right. Below the list, include a compact yellow outlined “+ 새 여행 만들기” button. Prioritize easy scanning, comfortable touch targets and restrained information density, keeping the list visibly more compact than the passport view.
ui_preference: 기존 여권 보기가 기본값. 사용자가 선택한 보기를 기기 로컬 설정에 저장.
scope: 목업 후 로컬 구현. 이번 요청에 배포는 포함되지 않음.
